references.phrase: indexed objects M_i and transition maps

references.disposition: Identity transitions and f_ik=f_jk∘f_ij are the defining compatibility conditions, without an assumed cofiltered indexing set.

review_rationale: Examined all transition arrows and their indices: the maps go from i to j when j≤i, and composition is tested when k≤j≤i. This is an inverse diagram over a preorder, not a direct system or a prerequisite of directedness.
